name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. Initially a journalist covering local rallies in the Czech Republic, he quickly recognized the power of storytelling in shaping public perception. He transitioned from reporting to crafting narratives, initially for smaller racing teams before gaining recognition for his creative campaigns. He firmly believes that a PR strategy must be as finely tuned as an engine. 

He is known for his relentless dedication to creating compelling media angles, often diving deep into the technical aspects of the sport to find unique stories. His approach is hands-on, personally managing media relations and ensuring consistent brand messaging. Jaroslav distinguishes himself through his ability to blend traditional PR tactics with innovative digital strategies, always seeking new ways to connect with motorsport fans.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jaroslav is a man of medium height with a focused gaze and a neatly maintained appearance.

quirks: Always carries a worn notebook filled with handwritten notes and story ideas.
Insists on having a perfect cup of espresso before any major press event.
Known to analyze competitors' PR campaigns in excruciating detail, identifying both strengths and weaknesses.
